desc: อุตุฯ ประกาศฉบับ 4 เตือนภาคใต้ยังมีฝนหนักถึงหนักมาก ไทยตอนบนรับมืออากาศแปรปรวน ระวังฝนฟ้าคะนอง ลมกระโชกแรง และฟ้าผ่า เช็กรายชื่อจังหวัดได้รับผลกระทบ 25-28 ตุลาคม 2569
title_cn: 气象部门发布第四号预警 南部强降雨泰北天气多变
summary_cn: 泰国气象部门发布第四号预警，南部地区遭遇暴雨天气，泰北面临多变气候。预警期间需防范强降雨、雷暴、强风和闪电等恶劣天气。受影响地区包括多个南部府县，预计10月25至28日为主要受影响时段。民众出行需提高警惕。
desc_original: อุตุฯ ประกาศฉบับ 4 เตือนภาคใต้ยังมีฝนหนักถึงหนักมาก ไทยตอนบนรับมืออากาศแปรปรวน ระวังฝนฟ้าคะนอง ลมกระโชกแรง และฟ้าผ่า เช็กรายชื่อจังหวัดได้รับผลกระทบ 25-28 ตุลาคม 2569

title_cn: 2026年10月25日泰国油价更新
summary_cn: 泰国各大油品公司（包括中石油、壳牌等）发布10月25日最新油价。本次更新涵盖汽油、乙醇汽油和柴油等主要燃料品类。消费者可根据公告价格在各加油站进行加油。油价信息关系到日常交通成本，车主和驾驶者需要及时了解最新价格动态。

title: 'No ID, No Ads' looms
desc: The government is intensifying its crackdown on online scams with a new "No ID, No Ads" policy taking effect on Nov 1.
title_cn: 泰国启动「无身份验证无广告」反诈政策
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出「无身份验证无广告」政策，自11月1日起生效，旨在加强网络诈骗防控。该政策通过限制无身份验证的在线广告，打击虚假广告诈骗活动。这是政府保护消费者、打击网络犯罪的重要举措，预期将有效降低诈骗风险，保护网民的财产和信息安全。
desc_original: The government is intensifying its crackdown on online scams with a new "No ID, No Ads" policy taking effect on Nov 1.

title: Airports told to brace for rain
desc: The Department of Airports has been instructed to prepare its facilities in the South for heavy rain, deputy government spokeswoman Ploythalay Laksameesaengjan says.
title_cn: 机场部门应对南部强降雨预警
summary_cn: 泰国机场部门奉命为南部机场设施做好强降雨防御准备。根据政府副发言人披露，该指令是在气象预警基础上下达的预防措施。南部各大机场需要检查排水系统、停机坪设施及相关基础设施，确保恶劣天气期间的运营安全和航班正常运行。
desc_original: The Department of Airports has been instructed to prepare its facilities in the South for heavy rain, deputy government spokeswoman Ploythalay Laksameesaengjan says.

title: Navy insists on fair probe into conscript's death
desc: The Royal Thai Navy has pledged not to shield anyone found to have committed wrongdoing in connection with the death of a conscript during training in 2024, following findings by the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) that he was assaulted and denied timely medical treatment.
title_cn: 海军坚持对征兵人员死亡事件进行公正调查
summary_cn: 皇家泰国海军承诺对征兵制度中的违规行为不予包庇。2024年间一名新兵在训练期间死亡，国家人权委员会（NHRC）调查发现该新兵遭到殴打并被拒绝及时医疗救治。海军方面誓言将对任何涉嫌违规的人员进行公正调查，不论其身份或级别。这起事件凸显了泰国兵役制度中长期存在的人权问题。
desc_original: The Royal Thai Navy has pledged not to shield anyone found to have committed wrongdoing in connection with the death of a conscript during training in 2024, following findings by the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) that he was assaulted and denied timely medical treatment.

title: Free trade pact with European Union shaping up for end of year
desc: Thailand and the European Union could conclude a free trade agreement (FTA) by the end of this year, says Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow.
title_cn: 泰国与欧盟自由贸易协议有望年底签订
summary_cn: 泰国外交部长西哈萨克·庞克凯可（Sihasak Phuangketkeow）表示，泰国与欧盟可能在2026年底前达成自由贸易协议（FTA）。该协议将成为泰国对外贸易的重要里程碑，有利于促进双边经贸合作，扩大泰国商品和服务的欧洲市场准入。这对泰国出口贸易和经济增长具有重要意义。
desc_original: Thailand and the European Union could conclude a free trade agreement (FTA) by the end of this year, says Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow.

title: Governors to collect royal fireboxes on Nov 20
desc: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat has ordered provincial governors to collect royal fireboxes at Government House on Nov 20 for public sandalwood-flower offerings honouring the late Queen Mother.
title_cn: 各省长11月20日领取皇家献花盒
summary_cn: 内政部常任秘书翁西特·三旁他拉特（Unsit Sampuntharat）已下令各省长于11月20日在政府大楼领取皇家献花盒，用于组织公众献香木花纪念已故皇太后。此举是对皇室成员的敬礼活动，也是泰国传统民俗仪式的组成部分，体现了尊敬与敬仰之心。
desc_original: Interior permanent secretary Unsit Sampuntharat has ordered provincial governors to collect royal fireboxes at Government House on Nov 20 for public sandalwood-flower offerings honouring the late Queen Mother.

title: Agriculture dept to review holy basil registration bid
desc: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has ordered an investigation into a company's application for plant variety protection covering four holy basil varieties, amid concerns the move could affect farmers' rights and traditional cultivation practices.
title_cn: 农业部审查圣罗勒品种保护申请
summary_cn: 泰国农业与合作部长苏里亚·朱昂荣兰基特（Suriya Juangroongruangkit）已下令调查某公司关于四个圣罗勒品种的植物品种保护申请。该申请引发关切，担忧可能影响农民的权益和传统种植方式。这一事件涉及知识产权保护与农民权益之间的平衡，反映了现代农业管理中的复杂问题。
desc_original: Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Suriya Juangroongruangkit has ordered an investigation into a company's application for plant variety protection covering four holy basil varieties, amid concerns the move could affect farmers' rights and traditional cultivation practices.

title: Stakes high for debate
desc: The no-confidence debate targeting 18 Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) ministers is expected to test not only the government's performance but also the political future of several key figures, with Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob emerging as a central target.
title_cn: 不信任案关系重大
summary_cn: 泰国即将举行针对18名国为党（BJT）部长的不信任投票，这场辩论将严峻考验政府执政能力及多位关键政治人物的政治前景。数字经济与社会部长猜查诺克·齐琴菊（Chaichanok Chidchob）成为投票的焦点目标。该投票结果可能深刻影响泰国政治格局，决定部分内阁成员的去留。
desc_original: The no-confidence debate targeting 18 Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) ministers is expected to test not only the government's performance but also the political future of several key figures, with Digital Economy and Society Minister Chaichanok Chidchob emerging as a central target.

title: FM praises 'progress' on Suu Kyi
desc: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow on Saturday welcomed Myanmar's decision to allow detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi to speak to her son for the first time in more than five years, calling it a sign of progress.
title_cn: 外交部长称缅甸昂山素季案「取得进展」
summary_cn: 泰国外交部长西哈萨克对缅甸当局允许被监禁的前领导人昂山素季与儿子通话表示欢迎。这是昂山素季五年多来首次与家人交流，标志着缅甸在人权问题上的积极信号。
desc_original: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow on Saturday welcomed Myanmar's decision to allow detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi to speak to her son for the first time in more than five years, calling it a sign of progress.

title: GDP will beat 2.1%  forecast, PM says
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) to reassess its GDP outlook after key economic indicators improved.
title_cn: 总理称泰国GDP增速将超过2.1%预期
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷下令国家经济和社会发展委员会重新评估GDP增长前景。随着主要经济指标改善，政府对经济前景表示乐观，预计增速将高于此前预测的2.1%。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) to reassess its GDP outlook after key economic indicators improved.

title: Chanthaburi border fence phase one done
desc: The first phase of the security fence at the Thai-Cambodian border is finished, while the next phases are progressing, according to local security units.
title_cn: 尖竹汶柬泰边境安全围栏第一期竣工
summary_cn: 位于尖竹汶府与柬埔寨交界处的安全围栏项目第一期已完成。当地安全部门表示，后续施工阶段正在推进中。该项目是泰国加强边境管理的重要基础设施建设。
desc_original: The first phase of the security fence at the Thai-Cambodian border is finished, while the next phases are progressing, according to local security units.

title: Social media guidelines given to NACC staff
desc: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has issued new guidelines restricting officials' use of social media during working hours and prohibiting online conduct that could undermine the agency's reputation and public confidence.
title_cn: 反腐委发布员工社交媒体使用指南
summary_cn: 泰国国家反腐败委员会颁布新规，限制工作时间内员工使用社交媒体，禁止进行可能损害机构声誉的网络行为。此举旨在规范廉政机构人员的职业操守和公众形象。
desc_original: The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has issued new guidelines restricting officials' use of social media during working hours and prohibiting online conduct that could undermine the agency's reputation and public confidence.

summary_cn: 一名澳大利亚女议员因肇事司机撞击而失去双腿，目前伤情开始好转。肇事者已被提讯出庭，面临造成他人重伤等指控。这起恶性交通事故引发关注。

summary_cn: 泰国勇敢党（Palang Pracharath）议员苏拉萨克·成万纳昆（Surasak Changwannakul）在63岁时去世。党领导人普拉尤特·占奥差（Prayut Chan-o-cha）在社交媒体上发表了悼文，对这位重要党员的离世表示深切哀悼。

desc: ผบช.ก.สั่งตำรวจกองปราบฯ สนธิกำลังเปิดปฏิบัติการ “ทลายเครือข่ายเว็บพนันออนไลน์” ตรวจค้น 9 จุด ในพื้นที่ จ.ชลบุรี จับกุมผู้ต้องหาได้ 8 ราย เอี่ยวแก๊งสแกมเมอร์ โรงงานผลิตบัญชีม้า
title_cn: 春武里警方破获网络赌博团伙 逮捕8人
summary_cn: 泰国警方在春武里省（Chon Buri）开展打击网络赌博行动，在9个地点进行搜查。警方共逮捕了8名嫌疑人，涉及经营非法网络赌博网站，并与诈骗团伙和虚假账户制造者有关联。此次行动是对非法网络赌博的深入打击。

title_cn: 警方逮捕在线人贩子 通过X平台贩卖儿童
summary_cn: 泰国警方儿童保护部队逮捕了一名在线人贩子，犯罪分子通过社交媒体平台 X 使用「接收萨空那空工作」等账户进行儿童性虐待贸易。目前已确认至少有2名16岁的受害女性。这是一起涉及网络儿童犯罪的严重案件。

desc: เผยแก๊งคอลเซ็นเตอร์ย้ายฐานหนีท่าขี้เหล็ก ซุกเมืองสาด ห่างจากชายแดนเชียงราย ราว 200–250 กิโลเมตร หลังทหารเมียนมาบุกตรวจค้นอาคารโครงสร้างสังกะสี จับกุมผู้ต้องหาชาวจีนรวม 99 ราย ยึดของกลาง
title_cn: 诈骗团伙逃离湄赛 躲入泰东北偏远地区
summary_cn: 呼叫中心诈骗团伙在缅甸军方突击搜查后逃离湄赛（Mae Sai），转移据点至泰国东北部距清莱府（Chiang Rai）边境约200-250公里的偏远地区。缅甸军方此前在铁皮房屋内成功逮捕了99名中国籍嫌疑人并缴获作案工具。
desc_original: เผยแก๊งคอลเซ็นเตอร์ย้ายฐานหนีท่าขี้เหล็ก ซุกเมืองสาด ห่างจากชายแดนเชียงราย ราว 200–250 กิโลเมตร หลังทหารเมียนมาบุกตรวจค้นอาคารโครงสร้างสังกะสี จับกุมผู้ต้องหาชาวจีนรวม 99 ราย ยึดของกลาง

title_cn: 曼谷市府回应赔偿金争议 称系正常程序
summary_cn: 曼谷市行政局（BMA）局长对200百万泰铢赔偿金支付的批评进行回应。官员表示赔偿金拨款符合财务管理标准，是正常程序，强调曼谷市按照财政法规认真工作。同时呼吁各方相互尊重，维护公务人员的工作积极性。

title_cn: 泰国政府延迟员工救济基金缴款至2027年1月
summary_cn: 泰国政府颁布皇家法令，受洪灾影响，将员工和雇主对员工救济基金（Employee Welfare Fund）的缴款期限从2026年10月1日延至2027年1月1日，以缓解雇主和员工的财务压力。

title: Anutin leaves door open to third coalition partner
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has not ruled out bringing a third major party into the coalition government, saying anything is possible in politics if it serves the national interest and strengthens government stability.
title_cn: 总理阿努廷暗示可能引入第三个联盟伙伴
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷（Anutin Charnvirakul）表示，如果符合国家利益并能强化政府稳定性，不排除将第三大政党纳入联盟政府的可能性，强调政治中任何事皆有可能。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has not ruled out bringing a third major party into the coalition government, saying anything is possible in politics if it serves the national interest and strengthens government stability.

title: School’s out for Uthenthawai
desc: Possibly the most controversial statement that could be made when discussing one of Thailand’s oldest and most violent school rivalries is that the remedy should not be controversial at all.

summary_cn: 评论文章探讨泰国历史悠久、冲突最激烈的中学对立问题。作者指出，化解这一传统学校冲突的解决方案本不应该具有争议性，暗示需要采取果断但必要的措施来终结这一宿怨。

title: Orange shadow looms over People’s Party
desc: The recent warning by former Future Forward Party secretary-general Piyabutr Saengkanokkul that the People’s Party (PP) should not allow politics to descend into “entertainocracy” is more than a criticism of political communication. It also highlights a lingering reality for the main opposition party: the political shadow of its predecessor remains difficult to escape.
title_cn: 「橙色阴影」笼罩人民党
summary_cn: 前未来前进党（Future Forward Party）秘书长皮亚布特（Piyabutr Saengkanokkul）警告人民党（People's Party）勿沦为「娱乐政治」。评论揭示主要反对党的困境：其前身党派的政治遗产难以摆脱，这既是对政治宣传的批评，更反映其身份认同的深层挑战。
desc_original: The recent warning by former Future Forward Party secretary-general Piyabutr Saengkanokkul that the People’s Party (PP) should not allow politics to descend into “entertainocracy” is more than a criticism of political communication. It also highlights a lingering reality for the main opposition party: the political shadow of its predecessor remains difficult to escape.

summary_cn: 在全球经济风险高企之际，专家指出逃离市场并非上策，反而将资金错配才是代价最高的风险。文章介绍了哑铃式投资策略——既非赌全球向好，也非赌全球向坏，而是通过资产多元配置为两种市场情景同时做好准备，帮助投资者在风险中寻求机遇。

title: Thailand may let under-18s play snooker by amending a 1935 gambling law
desc: Thailand may let under-18s play snooker by amending a 1935 gambling law Legacy Thailand is consulting on a change to a 1935 gambling law that would let people under 18 play and train at snooker and billiards, which the rules have barred them from since 1960. The same draft would move the supervision of boxing promoters to the Sports Authority of Thailand. The Department of Provincial Administration opened the consultation on Thursday, October 22, and it runs to November 22 on the government’s legal portal at law.go.th. The rules being amended are Ministerial Regulation No. 17 of 1960, issued under the Gambling Act of 1935. Billiards has been a recognised professional sport in Thailand since the Professional Sports Promotion Act of 2013, which has left the two sets of rules pointing in opposite directions. Under the regulation as it stands, nobody below the age of majority may play or train at it. The amendment would allow both, under conditions that have not been set out. On boxing, the regulation still refers to the Department of Physical Education and to provincial education offices. title: Chinese fugitive held in Pattaya, child may lose Thai nationality
desc: Chinese fugitive held in Pattaya, child may lose Thai nationality Legacy Immigration police have arrested a 37 year old Chinese man at a house in Pattaya on an Interpol notice sought by China, where he is accused of running gambling operations that cost 1.5 billion baht. The arrest also brought officers back to what they found at the same address last year, which has now put a young girl’s Thai nationality in doubt. Searching the house on April 10, 2025, officers found a 33 year old Chinese woman living there on a temporary visa granted because she was supporting a child who held Thai nationality. The child, a girl then aged two, was in the house. Her birth certificate named a 22 year old Thai man as her father. DNA tests showed he is not related to her. The man arrested this week is her biological father. Police have sent the evidence to the Pattaya registry office, which will consider revoking the girl’s Thai nationality. They are also pursuing what they describe as a trade in paid paternity, men hired to be registered as fathers on paper, and are looking at whoever certified this one. title: Tor、Lena联袂主演的影片《Her in Frame》 10月29日上线Netflix！
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国温情献礼佳作正式上线流媒体平台！由知名演员Tor Thanapob、Lena Lalina联袂主演的特别企划电影《Her in Frame》（泰名：เธอในภาพนั้น），官宣定档10月29日登陆Netflix，全网独家开播，院线落幕再启荧幕新程，让全球观众邂逅这份温柔治愈的泰式浪漫。 据悉，《她在那幅照片里》此前已于8月22日至23日完成泰国限定院线放映。影片凭借细腻动人的剧情、全员在线的演技以及治愈唯美的镜头质感，收获大批观众好评，口碑持续出圈，此次登陆全球流媒体Netflix，也让更多海外观众得以解锁这部诚意满满的泰国献礼电影。 该片为泰国重磅特别企划作品，由泰国能源部、泰国发电局联合Broadcast Thai Television Co., Ltd.倾力打造，兼具温情爱情内核与庄重献礼意义。影片创作灵感取材于泰国已故拉玛九世普密蓬·阿杜德与诗丽吉王太后的经典爱情故事，以光影致敬王室经典情愫，同时致敬现任泰国国王，诠释王室事业的传承、坚守与赓续，赋予浪漫爱情影片深厚的人文底蕴与时代意义。 演员阵容方面，影片集结泰国多位实力派艺人，配置堪称亮眼。人气影帝Tor Thanapob搭档气质女星Lena Lalina担纲双主演，此外Ta Athiwat、Non Intanon、Jennifer Kim、Jim Kunlanit等知名演员倾情加盟，全员扎实的演技为影片质量保驾护航。值得关注的是，本片也是知名导演Ku Ekasit首部执导的电影长片作品，首度跨界大银幕便深耕温情浪漫题材，以独特镜头视角解读爱与时光的意义，备受行业与观众期待。 影片以一张张承载岁月的老照片为叙事线索，串联起跨越时光的温柔情愫，褪去浮华滤镜，用细腻平淡的叙事节奏探寻爱情最纯粹、本真的模样。从限时院线放映，到登陆Netflix面向全球播出，这部融合泰式温柔、岁月浪漫与人文敬意的佳作，即将在流媒体平台开启全新热度。 10月29日，锁定Netflix，一起跟随《她在那幅照片里》的镜头，在光影与旧照之中，邂逅温柔岁月，读懂长久深情。 （编辑：Wan；图片来源：the standard） The post Tor、Lena联袂主演的影片《Her in Frame》 10月29日上线Netflix！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 《她在那幅照片里》即将上线Netflix，Tor与Lena倾情献礼
summary_cn: 泰国特别企划电影《她在那幅照片里》（英文名《Her in Frame》）将于10月29日正式登陆Netflix全球播出。影片由人气演员Tor Thanapob和气质女星Lena Lalina领衔主演，首次执导电影长片的导演Ku Ekasit以其细腻镜头讲述跨越时光的爱情故事。电影灵感来自泰国已故国王普密蓬·阿杜德与诗丽吉王太后的经典爱情，兼具人文敬意与浪漫温情。影片已于8月完成泰国院线放映，收获观众好评。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 泰国温情献礼佳作正式上线流媒体平台！由知名演员Tor Thanapob、Lena Lalina联袂主演的特别企划电影《Her in Frame》（泰名：เธอในภาพนั้น），官宣定档10月29日登陆Netflix，全网独家开播，院线落幕再启荧幕新程，让全球观众邂逅这份温柔治愈的泰式浪漫。 据悉，《她在那幅照片里》此前已于8月22日至23日完成泰国限定院线放映。影片凭借细腻动人的剧情、全员在线的演技以及治愈唯美的镜头质感，收获大批观众好评，口碑持续出圈，此次登陆全球流媒体Netflix，也让更多海外观众得以解锁这部诚意满满的泰国献礼电影。 该片为泰国重磅特别企划作品，由泰国能源部、泰国发电局联合Broadcast Thai Television Co., Ltd.倾力打造，兼具温情爱情内核与庄重献礼意义。影片创作灵感取材于泰国已故拉玛九世普密蓬·阿杜德与诗丽吉王太后的经典爱情故事，以光影致敬王室经典情愫，同时致敬现任泰国国王，诠释王室事业的传承、坚守与赓续，赋予浪漫爱情影片深厚的人文底蕴与时代意义。 演员阵容方面，影片集结泰国多位实力派艺人，配置堪称亮眼。人气影帝Tor Thanapob搭档气质女星Lena Lalina担纲双主演，此外Ta Athiwat、Non Intanon、Jennifer Kim、Jim Kunlanit等知名演员倾情加盟，全员扎实的演技为影片质量保驾护航。值得关注的是，本片也是知名导演Ku Ekasit首部执导的电影长片作品，首度跨界大银幕便深耕温情浪漫题材，以独特镜头视角解读爱与时光的意义，备受行业与观众期待。 影片以一张张承载岁月的老照片为叙事线索，串联起跨越时光的温柔情愫，褪去浮华滤镜，用细腻平淡的叙事节奏探寻爱情最纯粹、本真的模样。从限时院线放映，到登陆Netflix面向全球播出，这部融合泰式温柔、岁月浪漫与人文敬意的佳作，即将在流媒体平台开启全新热度。 10月29日，锁定Netflix，一起跟随《她在那幅照片里》的镜头，在光影与旧照之中，邂逅温柔岁月，读懂长久深情。 （编辑：Wan；图片来源：the standard） The post Tor、Lena联袂主演的影片《Her in Frame》 10月29日上线Netflix！ appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thai Lion Air restores Udon Thani to Pattaya flights to four days a week
desc: Thai Lion Air restores Udon Thani to Pattaya flights to four days a week Legacy Thai Lion Air is flying between Udon Thani and U-Tapao four days a week again, restoring a route it had cut back, nine days before Udon Thani opens an international horticultural expo that runs until March. The flights go on Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays. Udon Thani to U-Tapao leaves at 11am and lands at 12.20pm, and the return leaves at 1.15pm and lands at 2.35pm. U-Tapao serves Pattaya and Rayong and is the airport most visitors to the eastern seaboard use. The airline has not published fares for the restored service, and passengers are told to check with it directly because the schedule may change again. Thai Lion Air opened the route on June 11 last year as the first airline to take up a transport ministry scheme that halves landing and parking charges for a year on a new domestic route. The Department of Airports ran it to push carriers towards provincial airports. Flight tracking sites listed it at two a week through the middle of this year, which is the reduction the airline is now reversing. summary_cn: 泰国狮子航空已恢复乌隆他尼至芭提雅U-Tapao机场的航班服务，班次增至每周四班（周一、三、五、日），上午11时起飞，12时20分降落。这一复航恰好在乌隆他尼国际园艺博览会开幕前九天宣布，该博览会将持续至2027年3月。乌隆他尼机场已于9月获得国际地位，该航线系交通运输部推动新国内航线的试点，着陆费和停泊费可减半一年。

title: Germany grants Thailand 570 million baht for climate and coastal projects
desc: Germany grants Thailand 570 million baht for climate and coastal projects Legacy Germany is giving Thailand 15 million euros, about 570 million baht, for two climate projects, one on farming and biodiversity and the other on the coastal cities most exposed to rising water, Bangkok among them. The money is a grant rather than a loan, and comes through Germany’s International Climate Initiative, run by its environment and nuclear safety ministry. Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin announced it on Friday, October 23. It goes to the Department of Climate Change and Environment. The larger share, 10 million euros or about 380 million baht, funds a project called ENNaCT over five years. ENNaCT is meant to tie biodiversity work to cutting emissions, and to build green budgeting and other financing tools into agriculture’s supply chains. The second project, ANCHOR, is shared with the Philippines. Thailand’s half is 5 million euros, about 190 million baht, over seven years. title_cn: 德国向泰国提供5.7亿泰铢支持气候和沿海保护项目
summary_cn: 德国通过国际气候倡议向泰国提供1500万欧元赠款，支持两项气候项目：ENNaCT项目（1000万欧元，5年期）将生物多样性保护与减排相结合，在农业供应链中推行绿色融资；ANCHOR项目（500万欧元，7年期）与菲律宾合作，在曼谷、东部经济走廊和泰国湾等地采用自然解决方案应对海平面上升威胁。这是无偿援助，由泰国气候变化与环保部门管理。

title: American dealer held on Koh Phangan with 13 million baht worth of drugs
desc: American dealer held on Koh Phangan with 13 million baht worth of drugs Legacy Immigration police have arrested an American man on Koh Phangan with cocaine, ketamine, ecstasy and other drugs worth about 13 million baht, most of it hidden in a compartment built into a sofa armrest. Officers from Surat Thani immigration stopped Jared Dominic, a 34 year old who goes by the alias Dom, on Hat Yao Road at 4.10pm on Wednesday, October 21, with drugs in his socks. They then searched his house, where he sat down on a sofa and would not get up. Officers took the sofa apart and found the compartment. The haul came to 1.6 kilogrammes of cocaine, 1.4 kilogrammes of ketamine crystal, 340 ketamine pills, 2,540 ecstasy tablets, 349 grammes of MDMA and 72 grammes of 4-MMC. 4-MMC, sold as mephedrone or meow meow, is newer to the island than the rest of that list, and police describe it as spreading among foreign visitors. Also seized were packaging equipment, digital scales, a phone and financial records. The phone carried advertisements listing the drugs, their prices and discounts for larger orders. title: 曼谷突发持刀挟持人质事件！男子刀抵孩子脖子，警方成功解救
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 10月24日上午10时20分，曼谷无线电中心接到通报，称曼谷拉差贴威区碧武里路Yommarat立交桥下发生一起男子情绪失控、持刀挟持儿童作为人质事件。 救援人员及警方赶抵现场后，发现一名男子持刀抵住一名儿童的脖子。据接报信息，该儿童系该男子自己的孩子，具体性别暂不清楚。事发地点属于帕亚泰警察局辖区。 处置过程中，警方在现场与男子进行谈判，试图劝其冷静下来、停止危险行为并安全释放孩子。为防止引起民众恐慌，现场要求暂时停止使用相关信号。警方将确保儿童安全、防止其受到伤害放在首位，并谨慎控制现场局势。 最新消息称，警方已成功逮捕涉事男子，并成功解救被挟持的儿童及一名女性。 据记者报道，事发前，涉事男子与妻子曾谈及准备返回老家老挝，随后男子实施了上述行为。其妻子向警方表示，丈夫长期吸食毒品。 此外，曼谷第一警察总指挥部指挥官瓦拉萨警少将在Yommarat立交桥人质事件中亲自出手协助解救人质。 （编译：Wan; 来源：FM91 Trafficpro） The post 曼谷突发持刀挟持人质事件！男子刀抵孩子脖子，警方成功解救 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

summary_cn: 10月24日上午，曼谷拉差贴威区Yommarat立交桥下发生挟持人质事件，一名男子持刀抵住自己孩子的脖子。警方及时赶到现场，通过谈判成功劝阻嫌疑人，救出被挟持的儿童和一名女性。事后查明，涉事男子与妻子曾谈及返回老家老挝，而其妻子表示丈夫长期吸毒。曼谷第一警察总指挥部指挥官瓦拉萨警少将亲自参与解救行动。

title: Chiang Rai senator wants digital border passes to shorten Mae Sai queues
desc: Chiang Rai senator wants digital border passes to shorten Mae Sai queues Legacy A senator for Chiang Rai has asked the agencies running the Mae Sai crossing to put more staff on at busy hours and to turn the existing electronic border pass into a service that handles the whole process, from checking documents to paying the fee. Maneerat Khemawong set out the proposals on Friday, October 23, pointing to the queues that build at the crossing into Tachileik in Myanmar. Mae Sai is the main land route between the two countries in the north, carrying trade, tourism and the daily travel of people who live on both sides. She asked for more officers at peak times, orderly queueing and a review of the document checks, while saying none of it should weaken immigration control or national security. The border pass itself is where she wants most of the change. Applicants now move through separate steps to file, have the documents checked, collect the pass and pay, which she said costs time and crowds the counters. title_cn: 清莱参议员促推数字边境通行证 缓解麦赛口岸拥堵
summary_cn: 清莱府参议员曼尼拉·克海马翁建议麦赛口岸在繁忙时段增加工作人员，并将电子边境通行证系统升级为全流程数字服务，包括文件预检查、时段预订、状态实时跟踪和在线支付功能，以缩短通关排队时间。麦赛是泰国与缅甸达基利克的主要陆路通道，日均交通量大，涉及贸易、旅游和跨境居民往来。该建议同时强调不会削弱边境管制和国家安全。

title: Bangkok police run a donor heart from Don Mueang to hospital in 19 minutes
desc: Bangkok police run a donor heart from Don Mueang to hospital in 19 minutes Legacy Traffic police cleared a path through heavy rain on Thursday evening to move a donated heart from Don Mueang Airport to King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital in 19 minutes, the 197th heart the unit has escorted across Bangkok. The radio room of the Royal Initiative Project traffic police took the call at 5.15pm on October 22, at the end of the working day and in the rain. The unit sent a rapid-response team, mechanics and traffic officers. They worked with local traffic police, the expressway police and staff from the Expressway Authority to hold the route open. The running count gives a sense of how often this happens. On February 3 the same unit moved the 156th heart from Don Mueang to Thammasat University Hospital in 14 minutes, then the 157th from Saraburi to Ramathibodi over 109 kilometres in 55 minutes. That is about 40 hearts in eight and a half months. Pol Gen Itthipol Atchariyapradit, deputy commissioner-general and head of the force’s traffic management centre, praised the officers involved and thanked drivers who pulled over in the rain. title_cn: 曼谷警方19分钟完成移植心脏紧急运送
summary_cn: 曼谷皇家倡议项目交通警察在雨夜条件下成功在19分钟内将一颗移植用心脏从廊曼机场运送至朱拉隆功国王纪念医院。这是该部队今年以来护送的第197例器官运输任务，平均每周有将近5例此类紧急运送。警方与多个部门协作畅通运输路线，得到众多驾驶者配合，展现了高效的应急协调能力。副警察局长伊提普警察中将对参与人员表示感谢。

title: Thai floods recede to 16 provinces, with 64 deaths where water remains
desc: Thai floods recede to 16 provinces, with 64 deaths where water remains Legacy Flooding across Thailand has pulled back to 16 provinces and Bangkok, and the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation counts 64 deaths in the areas that remain under water. That figure is not a running national total. The department counts deaths in the provinces it currently lists as flooded, so the number falls as provinces come off the list rather than only rising. It stood at 67 on October 16, when 20 provinces were listed, and at 52 on October 7, when there were 27. The department said at 6am on Friday, October 23, that water still covered 60 districts, 432 subdistricts and 2,988 villages, affecting 375,726 households and 1,131,401 people. Levels are falling in every province on the list. Prachin Buri accounts for the most, 26, against 19 when the department counted on October 7. Samut Prakan has recorded nine deaths, Chachoengsao eight, Nakhon Nayok six and Suphan Buri five. Kanchanaburi and Samut Songkhram have two each, and Ratchaburi and Ayutthaya one each. title_cn: 泰国洪灾范围缩小至16个省份，积水地区死亡人数达64
summary_cn: 泰国洪灾范围逐步缩小，现已退至16个省份和曼谷。防灾部门统计，灾区死亡64人，影响约113万人口。10月23日，洪水仍覆盖60个县、432个分区，影响全国375.7万户家庭。其中普吉县 Prachin Buri 死亡人数最多（26人），各地水位逐步下降趋于稳定。

Samut Prakan has recorded nine deaths, Chachoengsao eight, Nakhon Nayok six and Suphan Buri five. Kanchanaburi and Samut Songkhram have two each, and Ratchaburi and Ayutthaya one each.
